prompt.en: Nunavut was created in 1999 out of which lands?
prompt.fr: Le Nunavut a été créé en 1999 à partir de quelles terres?

options.en: The eastern part of the Northwest Territories.

explanation.en: Nunavut's lands came from the eastern Northwest Territories, and they took in the whole of the old District of Keewatin.
explanation.fr: Les terres du Nunavut proviennent de l'est des Territoires du Nord-Ouest, et elles comprenaient tout l'ancien district de Keewatin.

source.quote: Nunavut, meaning “our land” in Inuktitut, was established in 1999 from the eastern part of the Northwest Territories, including all of the former District of Keewatin.

verification.evidence: Nunavut, meaning “our land” in Inuktitut, was established in 1999 from the eastern part of the Northwest Territories, including all of the former District of Keewatin.
